channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Essential £50k resurfacing works begin in residential street
item.description: Footpath resurfacing works in Rostwold Way are currently being carried out by Norfolk County Council’s infrastructure department.

item.title: Scrapped Sheringham bus shelter cash could be spent elsewhere in Norfolk
item.description: Money earmarked for the abandoned Sheringham bus shelter scheme could be used elsewhere in Norfolk.

item.title: Closure-threatened factory blames wind farms for fewer crabs in Norfolk's waters
item.description: Jonas Seafood in Cromer is at risk of closure because fishermen are catching fewer crabs off the north Norfolk coast - blaming wind farms.

item.title: Probe ongoing into Norwich assault which left man with life-changing injuries
item.description: A probe is continuing into a serious Norwich assault which has left the victim with life-changing injuries.

item.title: Fatal head injury of former nursing assistant to be investigated
item.description: An investigation has opened at Norfolk Coroner's Court into the death of a mental health nursing assistant who died from a fatal head injury.

item.title: City park solar panel plans given the green light
item.description: Plans for upgrades to a city park known for its ponds have been given the green light.

item.title: Father devastated after thief steals hundreds of pounds from charity display
item.description: Hundreds of pounds has been stolen from an annual charity Christmas light display near Norwich set up by Tristan Cork, founder of Finnbar Force.

item.title: Prime minister visiting Norwich TODAY to announce £46m government spending
item.description: Keir Starmer is due to visit Norwich to celebrate £46m in funding for Norfolk's bus services which will be used for new zero-emission buses, better stops and lower fares.

item.title: Owner of city's first rooftop sauna venue reveals opening date
item.description: Lee Tayler, behind Norwich's new sauna, studio and social space in White Lion Street, has revealed the opening date for the city centre site.

item.title: Change at the top of Sizewell C as joint boss steps down
item.description: Nigel Cann has been appointed chief executive of Sizewell C nuclear power station in Leiston, Suffolk, as joint managing director Julia Pyke steps down
